claims.claim: Native Rust accepts two distinct TryLike implementations sharing Output and Residual, with one reverse TryType.
The generic revisit_residual return type normalizes from declared Output/Residual equalities without assuming arbitrary TryLike identity. This is Rust type-checking evidence, not a Lean theorem.
Adding a universal TryType=Self inverse law rejects the otherwise valid Alternative implementation with E0271.
All three actual phase-isolated source cases pass the predecessor checker, then fail parent-trait agreement only after partial specialization; the checker is unchanged.

Constraint-aware canonicalization of repeated residual predicates is a candidate ingredient of a finite lifting repair. No canonicalizer, termination argument, producer implementation or preservation proof has been completed.
